exposure: peripartum hysterectomy alone for massive primary postpartum haemorrhage (Peri-hyst)
Emergency peripartum hysterectomy with bilateral internal iliac artery ligation (Peri-hyst + BIIAL)
outcome: failure of primary procedure to control blood loss
damage to ureters or sigmoid colon
cohort: The study participants were patients undergoing peripartum hysterectomy for massive primary postpartum haemorrhage.
finding: Patients undergoing peripartum hysterectomy alone for massive postpartum haemorrhage experienced significantly more ICU admissions, maternal morbidity, and maternal deaths compared to those who also received bilateral internal iliac artery ligation.
